segments.name: Nonalcoholic Beverages
segments.evidence: Nonalcoholic Beverages represents the vast majority of the Company's consolidated net sales and income from operations.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Includes the Red Classic subsidiaries, which do not meet the quantitative threshold for separate reporting.
segments.evidence: The additional operating segment, which includes the Red Classic subsidiaries, does not meet the quantitative threshold for separate reporting and, therefore, has been reported as "All Other."

revenueModel.text: Retail customers pay the Company for bottle/can sales of beverages, while other revenue comes from sales to other Coca-Cola bottlers, post-mix sales, transportation revenue and equipment maintenance revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Bottle/can sales primarily include products packaged in plastic bottles and aluminum cans. Other sales include sales to other Coca‑Cola bottlers, post‑mix sales, transportation revenue and equipment maintenance revenue.

changes.text: In 2025, the Data Ventures, Inc. operating segment was liquidated, dissolved and merged into the Nonalcoholic Beverages operating segment.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Data Ventures, Inc. operating segment was liquidated, dissolved and merged into the Nonalcoholic Beverages operating segment.
